title: Personal-Relationship Credit for Paloma Business Owners
content:
A monthly-billed Paloma Business account's subscription charge for a billing period carries a personal-relationship credit decided by the owner's Personal Sender Account, the owner's personal account with Paloma Remit, read from its verification level and its status.

### Credit clause

An owner whose Personal Sender Account is active at Paloma Private Client receives a personal-relationship credit of 25.00 USD; an owner whose Personal Sender Account is active at Paloma Premier receives 12.00 USD; every other owner, including an owner with no Personal Sender Account or with one that is not active, receives no personal-relationship credit.

The credit is a fixed amount in US dollars deducted from the period's subscription charge. Every fixed amount the charge carries, deducted or added, acts at the same point, on the monthly fee as billed for the period after any percentage discount on that fee: the charge is that fee less every fixed amount deducted plus every fixed amount added, and only that result is held at no less than 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent.

### By level of the owner's Personal Sender Account

| Personal Sender Account | Status active | Status not active |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Private Client | 25.00 USD | None |
| Paloma Premier | 12.00 USD | None |
| Paloma Enhanced, Paloma Verified Plus, Paloma Verified or Paloma Starter | None | None |
| No Personal Sender Account | None | None |

### Basis Q&A

**Whose Personal Sender Account decides the credit?** The owner's, that is the customer who administers the Paloma Business account.

**An owner's Personal Sender Account is at Paloma Private Client but is not active. Is a credit given?** No. The level counts only when the account is active.

**Does a Personal Sender Account at Paloma Enhanced earn a smaller credit?** No. Only Paloma Private Client and Paloma Premier, when active, earn a personal-relationship credit.

**Hypothetical figures.** A monthly fee as billed of 19.00 USD with no percentage discount, for an owner active at Paloma Private Client, and no other fixed amount on the charge: 19.00 less 25.00 is below zero, so the charge is 0.00 USD. The same, with a fixed amount of 15.00 USD also added to the charge: 19.00 less 25.00 plus 15.00 gives 9.00 USD, the floor of 0.00 being tested only on that result.
